reasons.a11yTitle: Native by design. Under your control.

subscription.title: Your {brand.openAI} key
subscription.body: Pay for requests directly through {brand.openAIPlatform}. {brand.holdType} has no subscription.

model.title: {model.transcription} recognition
model.body: An {brand.openAI} model for transcribing speech in multiple languages. The dictionary provides spelling hints for names and technical terms.

openAI.title: Extra correction is optional
openAI.body: After transcription, {brand.holdType} can correct errors with a separate {brand.openAI} request. This option is off by default.

useCases.title: Dictate. Translate. Fix.
useCases.intro: The same shortcuts and settings across your Mac. Dictation works in most apps that accept text.

aiPrompts.title: Dictation in the app you're using
aiPrompts.body: Use {brand.holdType} in {brand.codex}, {brand.claude}, {brand.chatGPT}, email and notes with the same shortcut.

everyday.title: Quick Fixes for existing text
everyday.body: Select text and shorten, translate or reformat it in place. Save recurring edits as your own commands.

bilingual.title: Translation on its own shortcut
bilingual.body: Dictate a reply in a familiar language. A separate shortcut translates it into the language selected in Settings.

features.appUiLanguageNote: The app interface is currently in English.

translation.label: Language and vocabulary
translation.title: Speak one language. Write another.
translation.body1: Choose a target language in Settings and hold {keyboard.translationShortcut}. {brand.holdType} transcribes your speech, translates the text and inserts the result.
translation.body2: Add names, project names and technical terms to {appUi.localDictionary}. It gives recognition a hint about how to spell them.
translation.imageAlt: {brand.holdType} {appUi.translation} settings with the translation shortcut and target language controls
translation.caption: {appUi.translation} settings. On a phone, scroll the image horizontally.

menu.imageAlt: {brand.holdType} menu bar popover with transcribe, translate, {appUi.pasteLastResult}, history, settings, and quit actions
menu.imageCaption: Dictation, translation, history and settings in the menu bar.
menu.label: Recovery and control
menu.title: Insert the last result again.
menu.body1: With {appUi.lastResult} saving enabled, insert the text again with {keyboard.pasteShortcut}. Your {brand.macOS} clipboard contents stay intact.
menu.body2: History keeps recent transcripts on this Mac. Open it from the menu bar.

privacy.label: Data processing and storage
privacy.title: Audio goes directly to {brand.openAI}.
privacy.intro: {brand.holdType} sends recordings from your Mac to {brand.openAI} for transcription using your API key. {brand.holdType} has no server of its own for processing speech. The app has no analytics or cloud sync.

items.apiKey: The API key is stored in {brand.macOSKeychain}.
items.optionalTextRequests: Correction, translation and Quick Fixes send text to {brand.openAI} when those features are used.
items.failedAudio: Audio kept for recovery after a failure or interruption may remain on your Mac, including after restarting the app.
items.recordingCache: Settings, dictionary and history stay local. Keeping ordinary audio recordings is off by default and can be enabled separately.

billing.title: Free app. Requests billed by {brand.openAI}.
billing.body: Usage is charged to the {brand.openAIPlatform} balance connected through your API key. Cost depends on the model and how much you use it.
billing.exampleBody: If {pricing.dailyDictations} dictations total {pricing.recordedMinutes} minutes of speech, transcription costs about {pricing.dailyPrice} at the default model's rate of {pricing.transcriptionRate} per minute. Repeat that daily for {pricing.daysInMonth} days: about {pricing.monthlyPrice}. Correction, translation and Quick Fixes cost extra.
billing.note: {appUi.billing} estimates transcription, correction, translation and Fixes costs on this Mac. Estimates may be incomplete for models with unknown rates. Actual charges and your balance are available in {brand.openAIPlatform}.
billing.imageAlt: {brand.holdType} {appUi.billing} screen showing an example of a local cost estimate
billing.imageCaption: Example {appUi.billing} screen. On a phone, scroll the image horizontally.

founder.imageCaption: Special recording hardware is not required.
founder.label: Why I built {brand.holdType}
founder.title: One tool I can use across my Mac.
founder.body1: I wanted the same dictation shortcut in the apps I work in, with translation and text edits close at hand.
founder.body2: With {brand.holdType}, I can dictate, translate and run Quick Fixes where I'm already working. Extra correction stays optional.
founder.body3: I wrote {brand.holdType} in Swift. The app is free, uses my API key, and I pay {brand.openAI} directly for requests.

apiKeyRequired.question: Why is an {brand.openAI} API key required?

parts.value: {brand.holdType} sends transcription requests through your own {brand.openAIPlatform} account. The key is stored locally in {brand.macOSKeychain}. If API keys are new to you, follow the

chatGPTPlus.question: Is {brand.chatGPTPlus} enough?
chatGPTPlus.answer: No. {brand.chatGPT} subscriptions and {brand.openAIPlatform} API billing are separate. {brand.holdType} needs an API key with {brand.openAIPlatform} billing configured.

cost.question: What does dictation cost?
cost.answer: The {brand.holdType} app is free. Requests are charged to your {brand.openAIPlatform} balance; you may need to add credit before getting started. {appUi.billing} shows a local cost estimate, not your complete account bill.

dataSent.question: What data is sent to {brand.openAI}?
dataSent.answer: Audio is sent for transcription. Correction, translation and Quick Fixes send text and instructions to {brand.openAI}. If nearby-cursor context is enabled, a short excerpt from around the cursor is added to the transcription request.

audioStorage.question: Is audio stored?
audioStorage.answer: Keeping ordinary completed recordings is off by default. Audio for recovery after a failure or interruption may remain locally after restarting the app. Additional recording storage can be enabled in Settings; it is also local.

compatibleApps.question: Which {brand.mac} apps work?
compatibleApps.answer: {brand.holdType} inserts text into most Mac apps through {brand.macOS} Accessibility. With {appUi.lastResult} saving enabled, you can insert the result again if the first insertion fails.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: Transcription can use automatic or fixed source-language settings. Translation uses the target language you configure in {brand.holdType}.

permissions.question: Why does {brand.holdType} need {brand.macOS} permissions?
permissions.answer: Microphone access records speech, Input Monitoring supports the global shortcut, and Accessibility enables text insertion into the active app.

sourceAvailable.question: Is {brand.holdType} open source?
sourceAvailable.answer: {brand.holdType} is source-available under {license.fsl11} with an {license.mit} future license. Each released version converts to {license.mit} two years after release.
